description: Native Shell is a native UI framework for iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Linux and the web, built in Rust.
vibe: Deep invariant verification, strict typing, and defensive boundary guarantees.
highlights: NSH embeds dynamically delivered native UI in apps and also supports standalone apps.
Rust owns the runtime, reactive graph, layout and renderer; QuickJS runs app code
(the browser's JavaScript engine on web). The toolchain is Rust, without Node.js.
assessment: Standard operational configuration for agentic pair programming.
